x-changelog.summary: Introduced Public API endpoints for External RFIs Filter Options
x-changelog.description:
Introduced the following Public API endpoints for External RFIs Filter Options:
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options (List available External RFI Filter Options)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options/status (List Available Statuses for External RFIs filter options)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options/sync_status (List Existing Sync Statuses for External RFIs filter options)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options/connection_status (List All Connection Statuses for External RFIs filter options)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options/rfi_manager_id (List Existing RFI Managers for External RFIs filter options)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options/responsible_contractor_id (List Existing Responsible Contractors for External RFIs filter options)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options/received_from_id (List Existing Received From Login Information for External RFIs filter options)
- GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/external_rfis/filter_options/current_revision (List Current Revision for External RFIs filter options)
